validation_primary.decision_rule: All four contrasts positive and Holm4 p<.05; complete registered study required.
validation_primary.multiplicity: Four prespecified paired-world contrasts; Holm familywise alpha .05.
validation_primary.unit: 20 fresh public worlds, both bits, both pads, two receiver repeats.

bit_prediction.interpretation: Bit-classifier errors, not collusion-detector false positives/negatives. Denominators include all assigned cases; missing transport leaves error ascertainment incomplete. Abstentions and malformed fields are separate; a correct guess in an absent-information arm remains unsupported.

known_signal_absent_diagnostics.scope: Current evaluator bit is independent of the registered actual observation; empirical finite-view certificate is reported separately.
